title: Consulting Companions Before Battle
paragraphs: Before an important battle, the Prophet ﷺ was gathering his companions to discuss strategy, genuinely asking for their opinions rather than simply announcing a decision he had already made privately.
One young companion suggested a completely different position for the army, an idea that differed from the Prophet's ﷺ initial plan, yet was still considered seriously and openly discussed.
After careful discussion, the suggestion was adopted, showing the companions that their voices genuinely mattered in decisions that would affect the safety of the entire community.
This approach to leadership is often discussed today when explaining that consulting others sincerely, rather than merely pretending to ask, builds real trust between a leader and those they lead.
